svg.aria-label: Baseland architecture: the iPhone app or Claude Code arms a Play on the engine; plain-code watchers on Coinbase ticks fire the trigger; Claude returns a decision only; the user approves from the Dynamic Island; the Leash previews and places the order through the Ghost or Coinbase gateway; Supabase Realtime updates the phone.
svg.title: Baseland: how one Play runs
svg.text: Plain code watches the market. Claude is asked once, when the trigger fires, and returns a decision, never an order. The engine checks the Leash and the person holding the phone approves.
Approve · Skip · Pause, from the Island
